{
  "project_id": "P-UK-FreeBreakfastClubs",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Delay in Treasury approval could postpone funding confirmation and push back the national rollout schedule.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage Treasury early, secure provisional funding, and design a phased rollout that can start with funded cohorts.",
      "evidence": "timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Schools may lack sufficient space or staffing to deliver the required 30‑minute supervised breakfast provision.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct capacity assessments, deploy technical estate advisers, and provide additional resources or alternative spaces where needed.",
      "evidence": "technical estate advisers to test what schools can do to mitigate any space constraints"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "The internal CRM system may not be operational by the November 2025 target, delaying onboarding of cohort 1 schools.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Allocate a dedicated development team, adopt agile milestones, run early user testing, and retain a manual onboarding fallback.",
      "evidence": "develop a customer relationship management system internally, working towards a minimum‑viable product from November 2025"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Lower than expected school participation could reduce the projected benefit‑cost ratio.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement targeted outreach, incentives, and regular monitoring of uptake to adjust engagement tactics promptly.",
      "evidence": "forecast for up to 2,250 schools... staggered take‑up assumptions"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Complexity of the previous funding model may cause confusion and deter mainstream schools from joining.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide clear guidance, webinars, a helpdesk, and simplified documentation for the new funding model.",
      "evidence": "variation by disadvantage levels was deemed to be complicated for mainstream schools, resulting in confusion"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "A gap in breakfast provision could occur when the NSBP ends in July 2026 before FBCs are fully operational.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Guarantee continuity arrangements, align closure dates, and offer temporary bridging provision where needed.",
      "evidence": "ensure they do not have a gap in provision after the closure of the NSBP in July 2026"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Delays in procuring advisers and launching the call‑centre pilot may limit support for schools during rollout.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Fast‑track procurement using existing frameworks, set firm milestones, and allocate interim support staff if needed.",
      "evidence": "procurement process to increase the number of advisers... start commercial processes to begin a call‑centre pilot"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Supply‑chain disruptions could prevent schools from obtaining food that meets required standards.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Qualify multiple suppliers, maintain buffer stocks, and embed contingency clauses in contracts.",
      "evidence": "Food provided must be in line with school food standards"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Unexpected inflation or labour‑market cost increases may make the daily funding rates insufficient.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Include an inflation contingency in the budget and review area cost adjustments annually.",
      "evidence": "area cost adjustment to account for variations in the labour market"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Delay or amendment to the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Bill could postpone the mandatory duty for schools.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Monitor parliamentary timetable, engage with legislators, and develop interim guidance for schools.",
      "evidence": "Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill will place a duty on state‑funded schools"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "DfE may lack sufficient skilled staff to oversee programme delivery and governance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit or second additional staff, provide targeted training, and leverage external advisors where gaps exist.",
      "evidence": "availability of skilled staff and resources, in both DfE and the education sector"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Data collection challenges could undermine the robustness of the programme evaluation.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Pilot the data‑collection system, use the call‑centre support, and implement rigorous data‑quality checks.",
      "evidence": "call‑centre pilot to support data collection"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "The £1,000 start‑up grant may be insufficient for essential equipment, training and systems at some schools.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Allow supplemental grant requests and issue clear guidance on cost‑effective procurement options.",
      "evidence": "£1,000 start‑up grant to cover one‑off costs... Schools are provided with initial funding to cover essential equipment, training and systems"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Keeping special‑school funding rates unchanged could raise equity concerns compared with mainstream schools.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Monitor equity outcomes and consider adjustments in subsequent funding rounds.",
      "evidence": "At special schools, the funding rate is... remaining the same from the EA scheme to year 1"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "If the evaluation is not perceived as independent, credibility of impact findings may be questioned.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Contract an independent evaluator, publish methodology, and ensure transparent governance of the evaluation process.",
      "evidence": "evaluation will be independently commissioned and run from 2026 to 2028"
    }
  ]
}
